obligations.name: channels_of_qualifying_reactor
obligations.description: Conversations that have, as a member, the user identified by the 💯 reaction on Priya's core-infra CUDA-memory-limit message; report every such conversation.

task_spec.text: Identify the user who reacted with 💯 to Priya's CUDA-memory-limit message in core-infra, then list the channels that user belongs to.

access_plan: Actor (agent1) is a member of core-infra, model-research, frontend, and project-alpha-dev, so conversations.history on core-infra surfaces the anchor message and reactions.get retrieves its reaction list; conversations.members on each of those channels plus core-infra confirms U_LUKAS's membership directly. Product-growth is a public, non-private channel that agent1 does not hold membership in, so it is accessed as a non-member via conversations.list/conversations.members (public-channel visibility) to confirm U_LUKAS's membership there as well. users.info/users.list resolve the reactor's identity for cross-checking across all five channels.
